title: LandlordGuard Renewal Late-Payment Surcharge Schedule
content:
**Schedule.** A LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal paid in full carries a late-payment surcharge that counts the late fees posted on the policy over the payment-history window up to today: two or more late fees give 4 percent, exactly one gives 2 percent, and none gives 0 percent.

The surcharge is added into the account adjustment percentage, which is applied once to the smaller of the indicated renewal premium and the capped expiring premium.

| Late fees posted on the policy over the payment-history window | Late-payment surcharge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 4 percent |
| exactly 1 | 2 percent |
| none | 0 percent |

## What is counted

- Each late-fee entry on this policy's premium account counts once, by the date it was posted.
- Installment fees and returned-payment fees are not late fees and are not counted.

## Hypothetical applications

| Late fees posted in the window | Surcharge added into the account adjustment percentage |
|---|---|
| 3 (window of 36 months) | 4 percent |
| 1 (window of 12 months) | 2 percent |
| 0 | 0 percent |

A late fee posted 18 months ago counts when the window is 24 or 36 months and does not count when the window is 12 months.
